themes.consensus_view: Four bank desks reference the Strait of Hormuz as a live oil-shipping flashpoint, but none has staked a directional view on whether disruptions worsen or resolve.

themes.consensus_view: Several banks flag AI-driven data centre buildout as a live theme, with ING the only desk staking a directional view that data centres will keep concentrating into clusters; nobody argues the contrary.

facts_agreed.claim: Multiple banks reference AI-driven data centre expansion as an ongoing growth trend across the US and Europe.
ING expects data centre buildout to keep concentrating into geographic clusters to share infrastructure.

themes.consensus_view: Chinese AI models have nearly caught up to the best US models on capability while costing far less to build and run, which the banks see as a real threat to the high-spending US AI trade.

facts_agreed.claim: Chinese AI models deliver near-frontier capability at a fraction of US development and running costs.
evidence_quotes: China's models are well positioned for this shift, given their structurally lower inference costs.
China's frontier models have reached around 90% of the intelligence level of leading US models.
the largest capital allocators are also the ones most exposed to over-investment risk

themes.consensus_view: Bloomberg warns that the surge of small-investor cash piling into chip-stock funds is arriving just as the market's spare cash dries up, making it likely to reverse fast.

facts_agreed.claim: Retail money is flooding into semiconductor ETFs at a pace that has grown sharply during 2026.
evidence_quotes: Money last in is often first out.

themes.consensus_view: Rabobank expects the Iran-US agreement to fall apart because Iran is unlikely to follow through on security and nuclear commitments, while other desks reference it without taking a directional view.

evidence_quotes: We assume the latter outcome as our base case failing a shift in Iranian deliverables
